desktopLinkNotRecorded: Node's desktop link has no order between an answer and an event: each call is its own HTTP /call answered on its own socket (src/standalone/session-transport/call-route.mjs:118-136), events are SSE frames written at once or, on a stalled stream, merged latest-wins per key (src/standalone/session-frame-stream.mjs:199-291, desktop-service-registry.mjs:31-49).

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replayLeftOut.core/health/updated: the core's stall monitor, sent on any connection when its runtime stalls; Node's phone path has no counterpart frame and no cause of this recording makes one

rules.answerWhileStateRecovers: core-only: Node never drops a state lane to recover it from a snapshot, it coalesces (desktop-service-protocol.ts:57-99), so a recovery snapshot has no Node counterpart; the core's rule (an answer does not wait for a lagged lane's recovery snapshot) is tested in mixdog-app-server-transport order::an_answer_does_not_wait_for_a_lagged_lanes_recovery_snapshot. Node's nearest counterpart, an answer passing the newest state held behind the one in flight, is recorded in state-latest-wins
rules.droppableStateLatestWins: one state frame in flight; later publications collapse to the newest and are sent once it is delivered (desktop-service-protocol.ts:57-99, remote-state-lane.ts:18-26), droppable when not critical (remote-relay-client-lifecycle.ts:273-278); scenario state-latest-wins
rules.eventAfterAnswer: an event queued after an answer is written after it: the same FIFO; scenario activity-after-answer
rules.eventBeforeAnswer: an event queued while a call is handled is written before its answer: one FIFO per phone, remote-relay-delivery.ts:81-101, coordinator.ts:483,1083-1172 (transport), remote-e2ee.ts:589-639 (legacy); scenarios terminal-dispose, room-rename, thread-favorite
rules.neverDroppedUnderCongestion: never-dropped events queued behind a withheld write are all written, in order, none merged: termActivity is not droppable (remote-relay-push-lanes.ts:150-152); a non-droppable frame waits in the coordinator queue (coordinator.ts:1097) or the E2EE send queue; scenario activity-after-answer, stalled

stall: stalled: every write of the desktop leg's socket is held with its completion callback from before the cause until the marker's handler is entered, then released in order (heldAtBarrier per run). A backlog of calls ahead of the cause is not used: Node closes a phone with more than 256 inbound calls not yet answered (remote-relay-clients.ts:23,214-218,349-352; a call's frame is released only after its answer was delivered, remote-relay-client-lifecycle.ts:329-339, remote-relay-client-calls.ts:501)
